gloss: intravenous infusion; IV drip; infusion fluid

definitions.gloss: intravenous infusion; IV drip; infusion fluid
definitions.explanation: The medical procedure of administering large volumes of fluid (saline, glucose, electrolytes, nutrients, or medication) into a patient's vein over a sustained period, or the fluid itself that is administered. Used to correct dehydration, restore electrolyte balance, deliver drugs, or provide nutrition to patients who cannot eat or drink.

examples.japanese: ⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{輸液|ゆえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: We started an IV infusion on the patient.

examples.japanese: ⟦{脱水|だっすい}{症状|しょうじょう}→脱水症状：30114_dassuishoujou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{輸液|ゆえき}⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I had dehydration symptoms, so I received IV therapy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れない→取れる：02376_toreru⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{輸液|ゆえき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{補|おぎな}う→補う：00329_oginau⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: While the patient cannot eat, nutrition has to be supplemented through IV infusion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{術後|じゅつご}→術後：15639_jutsugo⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{輸液|ゆえき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{速度|そくど}→速度：03319_sokudo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧⟦{細|こま}かく→細かい：01245_komakai⟧⟦{調整|ちょうせい}する→調整する：10442_chouseisuru⟧。
examples.english: In postoperative care, the type and rate of IV infusion are finely adjusted to match the patient's condition.

notes:
Composed of {輸|ゆ} (to transport; to convey, as in ⟦{輸送|ゆそう}→輸送：04084_yusou⟧ 'transport') and ⟦{液|えき}→液：02270_eki⟧ (liquid). Literally 'transported liquid,' the term covers both the act of infusion and the bagged solution itself.

USAGE:
A technical medical term used by doctors, nurses, pharmacists, and in patient charts. The everyday word a patient is more likely to use is ⟦{点滴|てんてき}→点滴：10580_tenteki⟧ (drip), which refers to the same procedure from the patient's point of view. {輸液|ゆえき} is preferred when discussing the formulation, volume, or rate ({輸液|ゆえき}⟦{速度|そくど}→速度：03319_sokudo⟧ 'infusion rate'), while ⟦{点滴|てんてき}→点滴：10580_tenteki⟧ is preferred when describing the bedside experience. Distinct from ⟦{輸血|ゆけつ}→輸血：04083_yuketsu⟧, which is the transfusion of blood specifically.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {輸液|ゆえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to perform an infusion
- {輸液|ゆえき}⟦{療法|りょうほう}→療法：13615_ryouhou⟧: infusion therapy
- {輸液|ゆえき}⟦ポンプ→ポンプ：11594_ponpu⟧: infusion pump
- ⟦{維持|いじ}→維持：01624_iji⟧{輸液|ゆえき}: maintenance infusion (to maintain fluid balance)
- ⟦{高|こう}→高〜：03951_kou⟧⟦カロリー→カロリー：06109_karorii⟧{輸液|ゆえき}: high-calorie (parenteral) nutrition

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{点滴|てんてき}→点滴：10580_tenteki⟧: IV drip — the everyday word; same procedure, less technical
- ⟦{輸血|ゆけつ}→輸血：04083_yuketsu⟧: blood transfusion — infusion of blood specifically, not general fluid
- ⟦{注射|ちゅうしゃ}→注射：01665_chuusha⟧: injection — a one-time push of medication, much smaller volume than {輸液|ゆえき}
- {生理食塩水|せいりしょくえんすい}: physiological saline — the most common type of IV fluid
